summary: A five-message week, all five from ALTR, zero from Hailey. She has not typed since 'Just sent it over' on 2026-08-20 - 15 days at window close, and this is her second consecutive zero-client week. What ALTR sent was: Mayson's new content Drive with a 7-reels-a-week quota (8/30), Mica's posting-consistency nudge (8/31), Michelle's scheduled leak-removal recap (9/1), and Stephski's Aug 15-31 invoice (9/1). Four of the five were asks, quotas or bills; none answered a single open question. Most notably, Mayson had asked her on 8/27 'how come you're not using the domain on instagram?' and then, without waiting for or chasing the answer, posted a fresh content demand on 8/30 - the .vip domains he built restricted two of her IG accounts on 6/13 and he has said nothing but 'Working on it' since 6/14, now 82 days. Nothing on the open board moved: shadowban investigation 37 days, phone-farm update Derrek owed 34 days, 8/20 wire receipt and destination account still unconfirmed 15 days. The 9/1 invoice repeated 'all payment information is at the bottom' and added new 'to avoid any pausing of work' language, without ever resolving the account-number contradiction from 8/18-8/20 or confirming her last wire arrived.

health.rationale: Fifth straight decline (80 -> 68 -> 65 -> 58 -> 54). Nothing new broke, which is why the drop is small, but nothing was fixed either: every open item aged another week and every recommendation from last week's report went unexecuted for the second week running. The composition of ALTR's output is the problem - of five messages, one was an automated recap, one a bill with new work-pausing language, one a new content quota, one a posting nudge, and none was a human answering something she asked. She is now 15 days silent across two consecutive zero-client weeks, which is at the top of her historical range (her longest prior gaps were 14-16 days), and she is going into a payment cycle where ALTR still owes her confirmation on the last one. Floor support comes from her payment record (25 of 25 cycles paid) and Michelle's leak recap being the one deliverable that has never missed.
